title: Constant-ring derived tensor under an exact flat-preserving monoidal functor
statement: Let J and T be Grothendieck topologies on small categories C and D in Type w, and let A be a commutative ring in Type w. Put R=constant_J(A). Use the published K-flat derived tensor on D(Mod R) [lem-weil-pbc-kflat-fixed-tensor-triangulated] and the native K-flat localization tensor on D(Sheaf(T,ModuleCat A)) [lem-sfb-constant-scalar-restriction-tensor]. Suppose F:Mod R→Sheaf(T,ModuleCat A) is additive, strong monoidal, preserves flat objects [lem-sfb-flat-term-kflat-functor], is a left adjoint, and preserves finite limits. For every K,L in D(Mod R), the exact derived functor of F sends their published tensor to an object isomorphic to D(F)(K) tensor D(F)(L). The two chosen derived categories may have independent Hom universes. There are no boundedness or finiteness assumptions on K and L.

source.place: Tags 06YS, 06YT and 0G7E: flat-term K-flat resolutions and computation of derived tensor.

proof.text: Use the proved constant-ring representative theorem to choose flat-term K-flat representatives of both inputs, their individual localization isomorphisms, and their comparison with the published derived tensor.
The flat-term functor theorem makes the second image complex K-flat; hence the target native localization tensorator is invertible.

Map the inverse source representative comparison under the derived functor. Follow it by the exact-functor localization factorization, the inverse cochain monoidal tensorator localized by Q, and the inverse native localization tensorator. Finally tensor the exact-functor factorization isomorphisms and the images of the representative isomorphisms. This is the required isomorphism; no natural choice of resolutions is needed.

lean.statement:
theorem constantRingDerivedTensorComparison {C D : Type w} [SmallCategory C] [SmallCategory D]
    (J : GrothendieckTopology C) (T : GrothendieckTopology D)
    (A : Type w) [CommRing A]
    [HasDerivedCategory (Modules J A)]
    [HasDerivedCategory (Sheaf T (ModuleCat.{w} A))]
    (F : Modules J A ⥤ Sheaf T (ModuleCat.{w} A))
    [F.Additive] [F.Monoidal] [F.PreservesFlat] [F.IsLeftAdjoint]
    [PreservesFiniteLimits F]
    (K L : DerivedCategory (Modules J A)) :
    Nonempty (F.mapDerivedCategory.obj
        (((SheafOfModules.KFlatFixedTensor.derivedTensor (ring J A)).obj K).obj L) ≅
      F.mapDerivedCategory.obj K ⊗ F.mapDerivedCategory.obj L)
